metadata.description: Senior engineers your AI agent can be. One persona per plugin.

plugins.name: grumpy-reviewer
plugins.description: Your agent's code, reviewed by the staff engineer who has rejected 4,000 pull requests, before it ever reaches your branch.

plugins.name: paranoid-sre
plugins.description: The on-call engineer who asks how it fails. Reviews manifests, charts, Terraform, and CI before they reach production.

plugins.name: tenured
plugins.description: The engineer who remembers the postmortem. Reviews a change against the repository's own history.
